summary_en: 3,000,000 shares (4.8% of outstanding) authorized for acquisition. Maximum expenditure ¥3.6B. Execution period 1 Jul – 30 Nov 2026. Method: open-market purchase on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Rationale: shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 18 June 2026, KPP Group Holdings' board authorized a treasury share acquisition programme. The company will acquire up to 3,000,000 ordinary shares, representing 4.8% of shares outstanding (computed as 3,000,000 ÷ 62,321,933 ex-treasury shares), with a maximum expenditure of ¥3.6 billion. The acquisition period runs from 1 July to 30 November 2026. Purchases will be made via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital policy execution in response to changing business conditions. As of the board date, the company held 4,922,351 treasury shares (including 1,922,351 shares in the executive compensation BIP trust account).
